propositions: T5c security rubric evaluation is decoupled from the shared preamble's evaluate-as-written stance; a criterion-local grounding override must ground findings in the current codebase and configuration via read tools rather than spec text alone.

30% of T5c advisories are template-shape undeclared-access-posture findings; multiple surfaces lacking declared posture yield N findings but should yield one finding with N surfaces in evidence (dedup-at-source).

46% of T5c strong findings cite repo artifacts despite the spec-as-written stance; ungrounded candidates citing neither read artifacts nor quoted plan sentences must be demoted to minor severity (blocked from high priority via existing pass3 machinery).
Only two HIGH-class finding shapes warrant severity >= major: plaintext secrets on boundary-crossing paths and undeclared internet-reachable sensitive surfaces; all other findings are at most minor.
T5c routing entry must change from advisory @ 0.95 to blocking @ 0.9 in criteria_routing.json with no inert blocking_enabled key; threshold_for resolves to (0.9, True) for gate=plan_review.

Rubric text edits, routing entry changes, extended parametrizations in blocking tests, and pinned blocking-set assertions in three test modules must all be delivered in one commit; passes.py and prompts.py remain untouched per ticket 9374 ownership.
